title.narrative: Activity under preparation Global Gateway to Education Facility

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of this action is to foster European Investment in the Caribbean. The Specific Objectives (Outcomes) are:Outcome 1: Partnerships between Caribbean and EU institutions, researchers, and businesses are created and strengthened through applied research collaboration in key Global Gateway areas such as renewable energy, sustainable water resource management, pharmaceutical production, inequality reduction, Sargassum, cybersecurity, and digitalization.Outcome 2: A skilled talent pool is developed through capacity building, exchange programmes, and the introduction of new qualifications, including dual and joint degrees in Global Gateway priority areas, with a focus on promoting European languages. Designed to initiate the partnerships around Global Gateway priorities, the Global Gateway Education initiative create partnerships and networks that should lead to a stronger participation of the Caribbean in Erasmus+ and, prospectively, Horizon Europe. It will specifically focus on tertiary vocational and technical education, partnering with private sector entities and technical/community colleges to support the Caribbean's Global Gateway initiatives in those areas with most job creation potential. Implementation modalityThe proposed action will be implemented through a service contract covering both outputs, representing the full EUR 6 million allocation. This approach ensures coherence across interrelated activities and allows for flexible, efficient delivery aligned with Global Gateway priorities.
